title: lepidium hirtum subsp. nebrodense
intro: Lepidium hirtum subsp. nebrodense, commonly known as Corsican cress, is a plant species within the mustard family (Brassicaceae) that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its ability to act as an antioxidant and vasodilator. The therapeutic actions of Corsican cress are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. Furthermore, the plant's leaves are rich in vitamins A, C, and E, as well as minerals like potassium and iron, making it a nutritious addition to salads and other culinary dishes.
